rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a military corps or battlefield formation.

example.english: In this battle, the corps was responsible for holding the eastern defensive line.
example.traditional: 今次戰役，個軍團負責守住東面防線。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zin3 jik6 go3 gwan1 tyun4 fu6 zaak3 sau2 zyu6 dung1 min6 fong4 sin3

rows.note: Use this for the general sense of an organized team or group united by a common purpose.

example.english: Our corps worked through the night and finally finished the project.
example.traditional: 我哋個團隊一齊捱夜，終於完成咗個項目。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 tyun4 deoi2 jat1 cai4 ngaai4 je6 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a diplomatic corps rather than an ordinary organized group.

example.english: The diplomatic corps arrived in Hong Kong today to meet the chief executive.
example.traditional: 外交使團今日到香港拜會特首。
example.jyutping: ngoi6 gaau1 si2 tyun4 gam1 jat6 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 baai3 wui6 dak6 sau2
